description: This file defines the interface for managing an array of object identifiers (OIDs), including functions for appending, lookup, sorting, filtering, and iteration over OID sets. It provides an efficient way to handle large lists of object IDs with emphasis on storage and processing efficiency.

methods.name: oid_array_append
methods.description: Adds a new object ID to the array, increasing its size and potentially reallocating memory.

methods.name: oid_array_lookup
methods.description: Performs a binary search for a specific object ID within the array, sorting the array if it is not already sorted.

methods.name: oid_array_clear
methods.description: Frees all memory associated with the array, resetting it to an empty state.

methods.name: oid_array_for_each
methods.description: Iterates over each element of the array, executing a callback function provided by the user.

methods.name: oid_array_for_each_unique
methods.description: Iterates over each unique element in the sorted array, executing a callback for each one.

methods.name: oid_array_filter
methods.description: Filters the array by retaining only those objects for which a provided callback returns true.

methods.name: oid_array_sort
methods.description: Sorts the array in ascending order based on object IDs.

methods.name: size_t oid_array_next_unique(struct oid_array * array,size_t cur)
methods.description: Returns the index of the next unique object ID after a given position; the array should be sorted.

ctags.name: oid_array_next_unique
ctags.pattern: /^static inline size_t oid_array_next_unique(struct oid_array *array, size_t cur)$/
